spec.description:
The Dashboard shows the latests alerts, decisions and allowlists exposed by crowdsec.
All data shown gets collected via prometheus-crowdsec exporter.

spec.expr:
(
  (0 * crowdsec_allowlists)
  + on (allowlist_name) group_left
    count by (allowlist_name) (
      crowdsec_allowlist_items
    )
)
or
(0 * crowdsec_allowlists)

defaults.noValue: Select an allowlist on the left.

spec.title: CrowdSec
